findings.source_quote: “Mothers who were applauded by society were suddenly bombarded with a new buzzword—fullfillment.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «selvrealisering» with «oppfyllelse» (or «fullbyrdelse») to convey the source’s “fulfillment.”
findings.translation_quote: «Mødre som samfunnet hadde hyllet, ble plutselig bombardert med et nytt moteord – selvrealisering.»
